compiler.selfHostingScope: RF2_SYSTEM_A64_V1 compiler source, bounded documented lexical subset

policy.limits: Finite policy and call-classification checks, not complete intrinsic semantics or memory-safety proof.

abi.scope: Finite local ABI/call-classification checks; default/optimized register and spill boundaries. Not a complete ABI proof.

memory.scope: Valid raw ranges, byte counts0..4096, word counts0..1024, unaligned/disjoint/exact-in-place copy, full region canaries. Partial overlap outside copy contract. No bounds/ownership proof or new Core/MCP effect.

sha.limits: Finite local checks, trusted raw pointers. ARM FEAT_SHA256 required for direct intrinsic; library queries Darwin and falls back on absent/failed query. Not crypto certification, reentrancy or memory safety.
